description: Contributions de la concertation réglementaire relative au projet d’aménagement du port de La Turballe conduit par le Département de Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Ensemble des contributions recueillies au cours de la concertation pour le projet d’aménagement de La Turballe organisée par le Département de Loire-Atlantique, entre le 20 août et le 5 octobre 2018 dans le but de collecter l’avis des citoyen·ne·s et enrichir le projet. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Citoyenneté / Institution. Its keywords are port, La Turballe, concertation, aménagement, participation citoyenne. The portal shows 206 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
